How do I sign a document?.answer: To sign a document, go to the E-Signature service. You can: 1) Create an envelope and upload your document, 2) Add recipients and set signing order, 3) Place signature fields on the document, 4) Send the envelope. Recipients will receive email notifications and can sign electronically. Our signatures are legally binding and comply with regulations in 40+ countries.

What PDF tools are available?.answer: We offer 30+ PDF tools including: Conversion (PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, Image, Text, EPUB and vice versa), Editing (Merge, Split, Compress, Rotate, Crop, Delete/Insert pages, Reorder, Add page numbers/headers/footers/watermarks), Forms (Fill forms, Create forms, Form recognition), Security (Add/Remove password, Set permissions, Digital signature, Remove metadata), OCR (OCR with 100+ languages, Make searchable, Handwriting recognition), Analysis (PDF info, Statistics, Quality analysis, Compare, Validate, Repair), Optimization (Optimize images/fonts/colors, Batch optimization, Remove unused objects), and Extraction (Extract pages, Extract tables). Visit the PDF Tools section to access all features.

How do I create a document template?.answer: Go to the Template Service section, create a custom template. You can use AI-powered generation to create templates from natural language prompts. The template service includes a form builder, template marketplace, and workflow automation features.

Is my signature legally binding?.answer: Yes! Our electronic signatures are legally binding and comply with legal requirements across 40+ countries, including ESIGN Act (US), eIDAS (EU), and similar regulations worldwide. We use digital certificates and cryptographic signatures to ensure authenticity and integrity.

How do I share a document?.answer: In the Document Service, select a document and use the Share feature. You can share with specific users, set permissions (view, comment, edit, full), and generate shareable links. Documents can be organized in folders and shared at the folder level as well.

What file formats are supported?.answer: We support multiple formats: Documents (PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, RTF), Spreadsheets (XLS, XLSX, CSV), Presentations (PPT, PPTX), Images (JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF), and Other (HTML, XML, JSON, ZIP). PDF tools can convert between many formats. Maximum file size is typically 50MB for documents and 100MB for PDF processing.

How do I track document status?.answer: In the E-Signature service, you can track document status, see who has signed, view signing history, and receive notifications when documents are completed. The envelope status shows: draft, sent, in-progress, completed, or declined. You can also view audit trails for compliance.

Can I use the API?.answer: Yes! We provide developer-friendly REST APIs for automation. The platform uses a microservices architecture with separate services for documents, e-signatures, PDF tools, templates, and support. Each service has its own API endpoints. Check the API documentation for endpoints and authentication details. Authentication uses JWT tokens.

How do I convert PDF to Word?.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'PDF to Word'. Upload your PDF file and the system will convert it to an editable Word document (DOCX or DOC format). The conversion preserves formatting, maintains text layout, and supports batch processing for multiple files.

How do I merge PDF files?.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'Merge PDF'. Upload multiple PDF files (you can select several at once), choose the order, and click merge. The system will combine all PDFs into a single file in the order you specified.

How do I compress a PDF?.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'Compress PDF'. Upload your PDF file and the system will reduce its file size while maintaining quality. For advanced options, use 'Batch Optimization' which offers presets like Web Optimized (40-70% reduction), Print Optimized (20-40% reduction), Mobile Optimized (50-80% reduction), or Archive Optimized (30-60% reduction).

How do I extract text from a scanned PDF.answer: Use the OCR (Optical Character Recognition) tool in PDF Tools. Upload your scanned PDF or image, select the language (supports 100+ languages), choose accuracy level (Fast, Balanced, or High Accuracy), and select output format (searchable PDF or plain text). The system will extract text and make it searchable.

How do I fill out a PDF form?.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'Fill PDF Forms'. Upload your PDF form, and you can either: 1) Manually fill fields, 2) Use auto-fill with AI/pattern recognition, or 3) Import data from CSV/JSON. The tool supports form field extraction, data validation, signature fields, and bulk processing. You can also flatten the form to make fields non-editable.

How do I add a password to a PDF?.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'Add Password'. Upload your PDF file, enter a password, and the system will encrypt the PDF. Only users with the password can open the document. You can also set permissions to restrict printing, copying, or editing even with the password.

How do I delete pages from a PDF?.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'Delete PDF Pages'. Upload your PDF, select the pages you want to remove, and the system will create a new PDF without those pages. You can select individual pages or page ranges.

How do I rotate PDF pages?.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'Rotate PDF'. Upload your PDF, select the pages to rotate, choose rotation angle (90°, 180°, 270°), and apply. You can rotate all pages or specific pages.

How do I extract tables from a PDF?.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'Extract Tables'. Upload your PDF, choose detection method (auto-detect, manual selection, or all content), select page range if needed, and choose output format (Excel or CSV). The tool uses AI-powered table recognition to preserve formatting and structure.

How do I add a digital signature to a PD.answer: Go to PDF Tools and select 'Digital Signature'. First, generate a certificate (or use existing), then upload your PDF, select the certificate, add signature metadata (reason, location, contact), and sign. The tool supports timestamp authority (TSA) for additional security. You can also verify signatures to ensure authenticity.

How do I create a folder for my document.answer: In the Document Service, click 'Create Folder' or use the folder management section. Enter a folder name, optional description, and choose a parent folder if creating a subfolder. You can organize documents hierarchically with nested folders.

How do I restore a deleted document?.answer: Deleted documents are moved to Trash and kept for 30 days. Go to the Trash page in Document Service, find your document, and click 'Restore'. The document will be restored to its original location. After 30 days, documents are permanently deleted.

How do I set signing order for multiple.answer: When creating an envelope in E-Signature service, add all recipients first. Then set the signing order by arranging recipients in sequence. You can set parallel signing (all sign at once) or sequential signing (one after another). The system will send notifications in the correct order.

How do I track who has signed my documen.answer: In the E-Signature service, open your envelope to see the signing status. You'll see which recipients have signed, when they signed, and which are pending. You can also view the audit trail for detailed activity logs including IP addresses and timestamps.

What is the difference between electroni.answer: Electronic signature is the visual representation of a signature (draw, type, or upload image) that is legally binding. Digital signature uses cryptographic certificates (X.509) to provide additional security, authenticity verification, and tamper detection. Both are legally valid, but digital signatures offer stronger security and are required for some high-security applications.

How do I contact support?.answer: You can contact support through the Support Chat widget (bottom right corner). Create a ticket with your question, select a category (technical, billing, documentation, feature, bug, or other), and our AI assistant or support agents will help you. You can also attach files to your support ticket.
